overview: November's papers centre on Euclid DR1 strong-lens releases (15,072 candidates; segmentation and lens-finding ablations), simulation-based inference with normalizing flows, flow matching and diffusion for LISA, gravitational waves and cosmology, and foundation models or agent tooling (EuclidFM, JAISP, MAASAI). New benchmarks include COSMIO, the FAIR Universe weak-lensing challenge and a 21-cm uncertainty simulator. Differentiable and neural-operator surrogates target galpy dynamics, MHD turbulence, neutron-star structure and Lyman-alpha mocks; homogenised stellar catalogues and ML source classification extend survey data products.
